witness.explanation: A normalization factor m=binom(j,a) was lost when identifying the script output with the physical quantity.
witness.evidence: The raw physical maps obey S_gamma S_gamma*=m K_gamma, so their nonzero A_gamma=S_gamma* S_gamma eigenvalues are m times the normalized k_gamma,mu. The common-line formulas are r_mu=||t_mu||^2/m and a_gamma,mu=m|d_gamma,mu|^2. Contracting |d|^2*r_mu instead of a_mass*r_mu computes the divided quantity T_b/m. A derived bound T_b/m<=B implies only T_b<=mB, not T_b<=B when m>1. This defeats the claimed uniform proof. The corrected finite T_b examples still pass; no physical T_b counterexample is claimed.
